notes.title: Update 0.38
notes.content:
[p][b]Added a physics-based bike[/b] to make it easier to move around the world in the second half of the game (by the way, it will also have upgrades and you will be able to attach a map or detector). [/p][p]I'll show you more details when I finish the open world.[/p][previewyoutube="LCcP1OSfDxQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Added TV[/b]. There are several "state" TV channels that are usually silent (but sometimes the signal gets through jammers).[/p][p][b]You can collect cassettes[/b] scattered in secret places and use a tape recorder.[/p][p]The recordings contain both "post - soviet memes" (added by "mods", so as game not to violate intellectual property), and things important for the lore. Experiments of scientists, the life of local "settlers", etc.[/p][previewyoutube="LVJUmctYeeg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Work on the open world is also slowly underway, added [b]new biome[/b], but this system is too complex, it cannot be done quickly. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129421/964637eccdf02e246cda201428f1b7a5ce9fc4d1.png"][/img][b]

[/b]Added [b]night vision[/b] device. Tried to make physically correct shader so that it would react to light correctly, glitches, and lens imitated.[/p][previewyoutube="x2yvQsQuj2c;full"][/previewyoutube][p] In the last video I added an [b]fps counter[/b], many people write "the game is on UE5, there are probably 5 fps and you need a 5080ti, we've already seen this in other projects".   It’s not needed, I’m a programmer first and foremost, and I worry a lot about the technical state of the game, redoing many things 3-5-10 times.  For example, I recently spent a 2 month completely rebuilding the systems, folders, and engine to make them even more flexible and simple. This work is invisible, but it is important for the development of large games and allows me to work on such a project alone.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129421/d3fa06e5f4017bfc243693d6fb926e3d8d1a1588.png"][/img] 
 
Project is alive and actively developing, I plan to move on to a large video format.[/p]

notes.title: Game announcement, answers to questions and road map!
notes.content:
Hello ascetics!
The modest announcement of the game attracted people's attention and raised many questions! I'll answer the main thing...

[b]What's ready in the game?[/b]
The game has a huge number of mechanics! To describe them all, I have created a road map. 
Which I will always support. You can see how development is progressing in real time!
[url=https://trello.com/b/CImWKXIF/asket-game]Asket roadmap (use any translator into English, (sorry))[/url]

[b]When is the trailer?[/b]
I have no desire to show “fake gameplay”. I will make a trailer as soon as the gameplay and plot of the game are finalized. 

[b]Are these Anomaly?[/b]
The essence of the game is a little similar. Free survival in an ever-changing world! This is where the similarities end.
The comparison with Anomaly was necessary in order to more easily explain the gameplay in this young and not yet fully formed genre!

[b]Release tomorrow?[/b]
Release when it's ready. Right now I just announced the game and it's out of final quality.

[b]What is the game about?[/b]
I am inspired by Tarkovsky, Roadside Picnic, post-Soviet horror stories and the theme of “ghost towns”. 
I created a new universe that has nothing to do with the Chernobyl disaster. I'm trying to develop the game in the direction of "post-Soviet mysticism", based on survival in a "ghost town"

[b]Normal optimization?[/b]
Tested game builds with our Discord community.  
At an average level, an RX580 will be enough, but for games at ultra and with reflections it is better to have a 3060 or higher, because the game is designed for Raytracing. 
This is the Unreal Engine 5 way, but I tried to optimize the game as much as possible (for graphics of this level).

(Thank you everyone for your support, follow the development of the project!)
